flagship_project.name: CollectEasy
flagship_project.tagline: Chit Fund Management & Offline Field Collection Platform
highlights: Offline-First Architecture: Engineered with IndexedDB client-side caching so field collection agents can record transactions without network connectivity.
Idempotent UUID Keys: Employs dynamic UUID keys ensuring zero duplicate financial entries upon reconnection.
Paise Integer Arithmetic: Calculates currency at the integer paise level to completely prevent floating-point rounding errors.
3-Tier Topology: Mobile Agent PWA client, Node.js REST services, and transactional persistent database.
Full case study dialog with architectural topology and technical metrics available in the portfolio.

database_architecture.client_storage: IndexedDB (browser-based asynchronous NoSQL object store for offline transaction queues, agent credentials, and offline chit ledger caching)
database_architecture.backend_database: Persistent transactional database accessed via Node.js/Express REST microservices

architectural_decisions.why_indexeddb: Standard localStorage is synchronous (blocking UI execution) and capped at 5MB. IndexedDB is asynchronous, transactional, and supports substantial structured offline storage necessary for rural field collection agents.
architectural_decisions.why_idempotent_uuid: Intermittent mobile networks frequently cause field agents to retry network submissions; generating dynamic UUID keys on the client before queuing guarantees the backend server deduplicates retries with zero duplicate financial entries.
architectural_decisions.why_paise_math: IEEE-754 floating-point arithmetic introduces rounding imprecision in JavaScript (e.g. 0.1 + 0.2 != 0.3). Handling all monetary operations strictly as integer paise guarantees zero rounding variance and audit-level compliance.
architectural_decisions.why_3_tier_topology: Decouples the offline-capable mobile agent client from the backend microservices, allowing local mutations to be queued asynchronously while protecting the persistent database with schema validation and authentication.
